keyPoints.en: After Japan surrendered, the British ruled Malaya through the British Military Administration (BMA), from September 1945 to 31 March 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas Jepun menyerah kalah, British memerintah Tanah Melayu melalui Pentadbiran Tentera British (BMA), dari September 1945 hingga 31 Mac 1946.

keyPoints.en: Its two aims: restore stability and peace, and win back the people's trust.
keyPoints.bm: Dua matlamatnya: mengembalikan kestabilan dan keamanan, serta memulihkan kepercayaan rakyat.

keyPoints.en: The BMA faced food shortages, a black market, worthless Japanese money and the armed MPAJA.
keyPoints.bm: BMA menghadapi kekurangan makanan, pasaran gelap, duit Jepun yang tidak bernilai dan MPAJA yang bersenjata.

meaning.en: British Military Administration — temporary military government after the war.
meaning.bm: Pentadbiran Tentera British — kerajaan tentera sementara selepas perang.

meaning.en: Illegal selling of scarce goods at very high prices.
meaning.bm: Penjualan barang yang berkurangan secara haram pada harga yang amat tinggi.

meaning.en: To break up an armed group, e.g. the MPAJA in December 1945.
meaning.bm: Membubarkan kumpulan bersenjata, cth. MPAJA pada Disember 1945.

points.en: Disarmed and disbanded the MPAJA (December 1945), paying each member and giving medals.
points.bm: Melucutkan senjata dan membubarkan MPAJA (Disember 1945), membayar setiap anggota dan memberikan pingat.

points.en: Arrested criminals and restored the police and courts.
points.bm: Menangkap penjenayah serta memulihkan polis dan mahkamah.

points.en: Supplied rice and other food; reopened schools and hospitals.
points.bm: Membekalkan beras dan makanan lain; membuka semula sekolah dan hospital.

points.en: Repaired roads, railways, ports, mines and estates; declared Japanese money worthless.
points.bm: Membaiki jalan raya, landasan kereta api, pelabuhan, lombong dan ladang; mengisytiharkan duit Jepun tidak bernilai.

question.en: State TWO problems the BMA faced.
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA masalah yang dihadapi BMA.

answer.en: Food shortages and a black market; armed MPAJA groups and law and order problems; damaged roads, railways and mines.
answer.bm: Kekurangan makanan dan pasaran gelap; kumpulan MPAJA bersenjata dan masalah keselamatan; jalan raya, landasan dan lombong yang rosak.

keyPoints.en: The Malayan Union was a British plan to unite the nine Malay states with Penang and Melaka under one strong central government; Singapore stayed a separate colony.
keyPoints.bm: Malayan Union ialah rancangan British untuk menyatukan sembilan negeri Melayu dengan Pulau Pinang dan Melaka di bawah satu kerajaan pusat yang kuat; Singapura kekal tanah jajahan berasingan.

keyPoints.en: Planned in London during the war; Sir Harold MacMichael got the rulers' signatures (October–December 1945).
keyPoints.bm: Dirancang di London semasa perang; Sir Harold MacMichael mendapatkan tandatangan raja-raja (Oktober–Disember 1945).

keyPoints.en: Introduced on 1 April 1946 with Sir Edward Gent as Governor.
keyPoints.bm: Diperkenalkan pada 1 April 1946 dengan Sir Edward Gent sebagai Gabenor.

keyPoints.en: The rulers lost their sovereignty, and citizenship was based on jus soli.
keyPoints.bm: Raja-raja hilang kedaulatan dan kewarganegaraan berasaskan jus soli.

meaning.en: A union of the Malay states, Penang and Melaka under a British Governor (1946–1948).
meaning.bm: Penyatuan negeri-negeri Melayu, Pulau Pinang dan Melaka di bawah Gabenor British (1946–1948).

meaning.en: Citizenship by place of birth — anyone born in the Malayan Union or Singapore could be a citizen.
meaning.bm: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan tempat lahir — sesiapa yang lahir di Malayan Union atau Singapura boleh menjadi warganegara.

meaning.en: Under the Union, the rulers' sovereignty passed to the British Crown.
meaning.bm: Di bawah Union, kedaulatan raja-raja diserahkan kepada Kerajaan British.

meaning.en: Body chaired by each ruler, dealing only with Islam.
meaning.bm: Majlis yang dipengerusikan raja, hanya mengurus hal agama Islam.

heading.en: a. Background — features of the Malayan Union
heading.bm: a. Latar belakang — ciri-ciri Malayan Union

points.en: Central government under a Governor, with Executive and Legislative Councils.
points.bm: Kerajaan pusat di bawah Gabenor, dengan Majlis Mesyuarat Kerja dan Majlis Undangan.

points.en: Malay rulers only headed Islamic affairs through a Malay Advisory Council; real power was with the Governor.
points.bm: Raja-raja Melayu hanya mengetuai hal agama Islam melalui Majlis Penasihat Melayu; kuasa sebenar di tangan Gabenor.

points.en: British wanted a cheaper, efficient single government, control of Malaya's wealth and to prepare for self-rule on its terms.
points.bm: British mahukan pentadbiran tunggal yang cekap dan jimat, menguasai kekayaan Tanah Melayu dan menyediakan pemerintahan sendiri mengikut acuannya.

points.en: Jus soli: those born in the Malayan Union or Singapore became citizens.
points.bm: Jus soli: mereka yang lahir di Malayan Union atau Singapura menjadi warganegara.

points.en: Others could apply after living here 10 of the 15 years before 15 February 1942.
points.bm: Orang lain boleh memohon selepas tinggal di sini 10 daripada 15 tahun sebelum 15 Februari 1942.

heading.en: b. British obtain the rulers' signatures

points.en: MacMichael met each ruler and pressed them to sign quickly.
points.bm: MacMichael menemui setiap raja dan mendesak mereka menandatangani dengan segera.

points.en: Methods: threatening to investigate their cooperation with the Japanese and to dethrone them; giving little time to consult.
points.bm: Cara: mengugut untuk menyiasat kerjasama mereka dengan Jepun dan menurunkan mereka dari takhta; memberi masa yang singkat untuk berunding.

event.en: British White Paper on the Malayan Union.
event.bm: Kertas Putih British tentang Malayan Union.

event.en: Malayan Union begins; Sir Edward Gent becomes Governor.
event.bm: Malayan Union bermula; Sir Edward Gent menjadi Gabenor.

question.en: Why was jus soli citizenship a threat to the Malays?
question.bm: Mengapakah kewarganegaraan jus soli menjadi ancaman kepada orang Melayu?

answer.en: It would quickly make large numbers of immigrants citizens with equal rights, so the Malays feared losing their special position and political power in their own land.
answer.bm: Ia akan menjadikan ramai imigran warganegara dengan hak sama, maka orang Melayu bimbang kehilangan kedudukan istimewa dan kuasa politik di tanah air sendiri.

tip.en: Features of MU: Gabenor, kerajaan pusat, raja hilang kedaulatan, Majlis Penasihat Melayu, jus soli, Singapura berasingan.
tip.bm: Ciri MU: Gabenor, kerajaan pusat, raja hilang kedaulatan, Majlis Penasihat Melayu, jus soli, Singapura berasingan.

keyPoints.en: Malay rulers and people united to oppose the Malayan Union.
keyPoints.bm: Raja-raja Melayu dan rakyat bersatu menentang Malayan Union.

keyPoints.en: The rulers boycotted Governor Gent's installation on 1 April 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Raja-raja memulaukan majlis pelantikan Gabenor Gent pada 1 April 1946.

keyPoints.en: The Pan-Malayan Malay Congress (1–4 March 1946) led to the founding of UMNO on 11 May 1946, with Dato' Onn Jaafar as president.
keyPoints.bm: Kongres Melayu Se-Malaya (1–4 Mac 1946) membawa kepada penubuhan UMNO pada 11 Mei 1946, dengan Dato' Onn Jaafar sebagai Yang Dipertua.

keyPoints.en: Former British officials in Britain also criticised the plan.
keyPoints.bm: Bekas pegawai British di Britain turut mengkritik rancangan ini.

meaning.en: Refusing to take part as a protest.
meaning.bm: Enggan mengambil bahagian sebagai tanda bantahan.

meaning.en: United Malays National Organisation, founded 11 May 1946 in Johor Bahru.
meaning.bm: Pertubuhan Kebangsaan Melayu Bersatu, ditubuhkan 11 Mei 1946 di Johor Bahru.

meaning.en: Meeting of 41 Malay associations at the Sultan Sulaiman Club, Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur (March 1946).
meaning.bm: Perhimpunan 41 persatuan Melayu di Kelab Sultan Sulaiman, Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur (Mac 1946).

heading.en: a. Opposition by the Malay rulers

points.en: Boycotted the Governor's installation and refused to attend meetings of the Advisory Council.
points.bm: Memulaukan pelantikan Gabenor dan enggan menghadiri mesyuarat Majlis Penasihat.

points.en: Sent a letter of protest to the British government, saying they had signed under pressure.
points.bm: Menghantar surat bantahan kepada kerajaan British, menyatakan mereka menandatangani di bawah tekanan.

points.en: Malay newspapers (e.g. Utusan Melayu, Majlis) published strong criticism.
points.bm: Akhbar Melayu (cth. Utusan Melayu, Majlis) menyiarkan kritikan yang keras.

points.en: Intellectuals and women took part in rallies; Malay associations organised protests.
points.bm: Golongan cendekiawan dan wanita menyertai perhimpunan; persatuan Melayu menganjurkan bantahan.

points.en: Protests in Kelantan, Kedah and Johor, e.g. Dato' Onn's Pergerakan Melayu Semenanjung in Johor.
points.bm: Bantahan di Kelantan, Kedah dan Johor, cth. Pergerakan Melayu Semenanjung pimpinan Dato' Onn di Johor.

points.en: Malays wore white bands on their songkok as a sign of mourning for seven days.
points.bm: Orang Melayu memakai kain putih pada songkok sebagai tanda berkabung selama tujuh hari.

points.en: UMNO held large-scale protests across the country.
points.bm: UMNO mengadakan bantahan besar-besaran di seluruh negara.

points.en: Britain agreed to replace the Malayan Union; the Federation of Malaya began on 1 February 1948.
points.bm: British bersetuju menggantikan Malayan Union; Persekutuan Tanah Melayu bermula pada 1 Februari 1948.

event.en: First Pan-Malayan Malay Congress, Kuala Lumpur.
event.bm: Kongres Melayu Se-Malaya pertama, Kuala Lumpur.

event.en: Federation of Malaya replaces the Union.

question.en: What was the most significant result of the anti-Malayan Union movement?
question.bm: Apakah kesan paling penting gerakan menentang Malayan Union?

answer.en: It united the Malays under UMNO for the first time and forced Britain to replace the Union with the Federation of Malaya 1948 — the start of the road to independence.
answer.bm: Ia menyatukan orang Melayu di bawah UMNO buat pertama kali dan memaksa British menggantikan Union dengan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1948 — permulaan jalan ke arah kemerdekaan.

keyPoints.en: After the war Sarawak was under military administration until Rajah Charles Vyner Brooke returned in April 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas perang Sarawak di bawah pentadbiran tentera sehingga Rajah Charles Vyner Brooke kembali pada April 1946.

keyPoints.en: Vyner Brooke decided to hand (cede) Sarawak to the British Crown.
keyPoints.bm: Vyner Brooke memutuskan untuk menyerahkan Sarawak kepada Kerajaan British.

keyPoints.en: The Council Negri approved the cession by a narrow vote (19–16) in May 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Majlis Negeri meluluskan penyerahan dengan undian tipis (19–16) pada Mei 1946.

keyPoints.en: Sarawak became a British Crown Colony on 1 July 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota British pada 1 Julai 1946.

meaning.en: Formally handing a territory to another power.
meaning.bm: Menyerahkan wilayah secara rasmi kepada kuasa lain.

meaning.en: A territory ruled directly by the British government through a Governor.
meaning.bm: Wilayah yang diperintah terus oleh kerajaan British melalui seorang Gabenor.

meaning.en: Sarawak's state council that voted on the cession.
meaning.bm: Majlis negeri Sarawak yang mengundi tentang penyerahan.

points.en: Australian and then British military officers ran Sarawak after the Japanese surrender.
points.bm: Pegawai tentera Australia dan kemudian British mentadbir Sarawak selepas Jepun menyerah kalah.

points.en: The Brooke government had no money to rebuild Sarawak after the war.
points.bm: Kerajaan Brooke tidak mempunyai wang untuk membangunkan semula Sarawak selepas perang.

points.en: Vyner Brooke had no son to succeed him and disagreed with his nephew Anthony Brooke.
points.bm: Vyner Brooke tiada anak lelaki sebagai pengganti dan berselisih dengan anak saudaranya Anthony Brooke.

points.en: Britain wanted direct control of Sarawak for its own interests.
points.bm: British mahu menguasai Sarawak secara langsung demi kepentingannya.

points.en: A bill was debated in the Council Negri (May 1946) and passed 19–16.
points.bm: Satu rang undang-undang dibahaskan dalam Majlis Negeri (Mei 1946) dan diluluskan 19–16.

points.en: The cession document was signed and Sarawak became a Crown Colony on 1 July 1946.
points.bm: Dokumen penyerahan ditandatangani dan Sarawak menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota pada 1 Julai 1946.

question.en: Why was the vote in the Council Negri important?
question.bm: Mengapakah undian dalam Majlis Negeri penting?

answer.en: The very narrow 19–16 result showed many members — especially local members — opposed the cession, which fuelled the anti-cession movement.
answer.bm: Keputusan yang sangat tipis 19–16 menunjukkan ramai ahli — terutamanya ahli tempatan — menentang penyerahan, lalu mencetuskan gerakan anti-penyerahan.

keyPoints.en: Many Sarawakians opposed the cession because Brooke had promised to lead Sarawak to self-government.
keyPoints.bm: Ramai rakyat Sarawak menentang penyerahan kerana Brooke pernah berjanji membawa Sarawak ke arah pemerintahan sendiri.

keyPoints.en: Opposition came from groups such as the Persatuan Kebangsaan Melayu Sarawak, Pergerakan Pemuda Melayu and Dayak associations.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan datang daripada kumpulan seperti Persatuan Kebangsaan Melayu Sarawak, Pergerakan Pemuda Melayu dan persatuan Dayak.

keyPoints.en: When Circular No. 9 banned civil servants from joining, 338 Malay teachers and government staff resigned.
keyPoints.bm: Apabila Pekeliling No. 9 melarang kakitangan kerajaan menyertai gerakan ini, 338 orang guru dan kakitangan kerajaan Melayu meletakkan jawatan.

keyPoints.en: Rosli Dhobi of the Rukun 13 group stabbed Governor Duncan Stewart in Sibu (3 December 1949); he and others were executed in 1950.
keyPoints.bm: Rosli Dhobi dari kumpulan Rukun 13 menikam Gabenor Duncan Stewart di Sibu (3 Disember 1949); beliau dan rakan-rakannya dihukum gantung pada 1950.

meaning.en: Struggle in Sarawak (1946–1950) against handing Sarawak to Britain.
meaning.bm: Perjuangan di Sarawak (1946–1950) menentang penyerahan Sarawak kepada British.

meaning.en: British order (1946) forbidding civil servants from joining the anti-cession movement.
meaning.bm: Arahan British (1946) yang melarang kakitangan kerajaan menyertai gerakan anti-penyerahan.

meaning.en: Secret group in Sibu that planned to kill British officials.
meaning.bm: Kumpulan sulit di Sibu yang merancang membunuh pegawai British.

heading.en: a. Reasons for opposing the cession

points.en: It broke the Brooke promise (1941 constitution) of self-government.
points.bm: Ia melanggar janji Brooke (perlembagaan 1941) tentang pemerintahan sendiri.

points.en: Local people were not properly consulted; the Council Negri vote was narrow.
points.bm: Penduduk tempatan tidak dirunding dengan sewajarnya; undian Majlis Negeri sangat tipis.

points.en: Meetings, protest letters, petitions and wearing anti-cession badges.
points.bm: Perjumpaan, surat bantahan, petisyen dan memakai lencana anti-penyerahan.

points.en: Mass resignation of 338 civil servants and teachers.
points.bm: Peletakan jawatan beramai-ramai oleh 338 kakitangan kerajaan dan guru.

points.en: Armed act: the assassination of Governor Duncan Stewart by Rosli Dhobi.
points.bm: Tindakan bersenjata: pembunuhan Gabenor Duncan Stewart oleh Rosli Dhobi.

heading.en: c. Those who supported the cession

points.en: Some local leaders and many Chinese traders hoped British rule would bring development and stability.
points.bm: Sesetengah pemimpin tempatan dan ramai pedagang Cina berharap pemerintahan British membawa pembangunan dan kestabilan.

event.en: 338 civil servants resign over Circular No. 9.
event.bm: 338 kakitangan meletakkan jawatan kerana Pekeliling No. 9.

event.en: Rosli Dhobi stabs Governor Duncan Stewart in Sibu.
event.bm: Rosli Dhobi menikam Gabenor Duncan Stewart di Sibu.
Rosli Dhobi dan rakan-rakan dihukum gantung.

question.en: Explain TWO forms of opposition to the cession of Sarawak.
question.bm: Jelaskan DUA bentuk penentangan terhadap penyerahan Sarawak.

answer.en: (1) Peaceful protest: meetings, petitions and the resignation of 338 civil servants and teachers. (2) Violent action: Rukun 13's Rosli Dhobi killed Governor Duncan Stewart in 1949.
answer.bm: (1) Bantahan aman: perjumpaan, petisyen dan peletakan jawatan 338 kakitangan dan guru. (2) Tindakan kekerasan: Rosli Dhobi dari Rukun 13 membunuh Gabenor Duncan Stewart pada 1949.

keyPoints.en: North Borneo (Sabah) had been run by the British North Borneo Company (BNBC) since 1881.
keyPoints.bm: Borneo Utara (Sabah) ditadbir oleh Syarikat Borneo Utara British (SBUB) sejak 1881.

keyPoints.en: The war destroyed towns such as Jesselton and Sandakan; the Company could not afford to rebuild.
keyPoints.bm: Perang memusnahkan bandar seperti Jesselton dan Sandakan; syarikat tidak mampu membangunkannya semula.

keyPoints.en: The Company handed Sabah to the British Crown on 15 July 1946; Labuan was joined to it.
keyPoints.bm: Syarikat menyerahkan Sabah kepada Kerajaan British pada 15 Julai 1946; Labuan digabungkan bersamanya.

meaning.en: British North Borneo Chartered Company — a company that ruled Sabah until 1946.
meaning.bm: Syarikat Berpiagam Borneo Utara British — syarikat yang memerintah Sabah hingga 1946.

meaning.en: Sabah's status from 1946 to 1963, with Jesselton as capital.
meaning.bm: Status Sabah dari 1946 hingga 1963, dengan Jesselton sebagai ibu negeri.

points.en: Huge war damage and a lack of money to rebuild.
points.bm: Kemusnahan besar akibat perang dan kekurangan wang untuk membangunkan semula.

points.en: Britain wanted direct control for strategic and economic reasons.
points.bm: British mahukan kawalan langsung atas sebab strategik dan ekonomi.

points.en: The capital moved from Sandakan (destroyed) to Jesselton.
points.bm: Ibu negeri dipindahkan dari Sandakan (musnah) ke Jesselton.

question.en: Why did the BNBC hand Sabah to the British government?
question.bm: Mengapakah SBUB menyerahkan Sabah kepada kerajaan British?

answer.en: The Japanese Occupation and Allied bombing had destroyed much of Sabah, and the Company did not have the money to rebuild it.
answer.bm: Pendudukan Jepun dan pengeboman Berikat memusnahkan sebahagian besar Sabah, dan syarikat tidak mempunyai wang untuk membangunkannya semula.

keyPoints.en: In Sabah there was less open opposition to the handover than in Sarawak.
keyPoints.bm: Di Sabah penentangan terbuka terhadap penyerahan kurang berbanding di Sarawak.

keyPoints.en: British policy suppressed political associations and limited local people's chances in the administration.
keyPoints.bm: Dasar British menyekat kegiatan berpersatuan dan mengehadkan peluang penduduk tempatan dalam pentadbiran.

keyPoints.en: After the war, most people were busy rebuilding their lives and livelihoods.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas perang, kebanyakan penduduk sibuk membina semula kehidupan dan mata pencarian.

meaning.en: People's concern for jobs, homes, food and services after the war.
meaning.bm: Keprihatinan rakyat terhadap pekerjaan, rumah, makanan dan perkhidmatan selepas perang.

points.en: Suppressed associations so that political movements could not grow.
points.bm: Menyekat kegiatan berpersatuan supaya gerakan politik tidak berkembang.

points.en: Limited opportunities for locals in senior government posts.
points.bm: Mengehadkan peluang penduduk tempatan dalam jawatan kanan kerajaan.

heading.en: b. Socio-economic interests of the people

points.en: Communities focused on rebuilding homes, farms and businesses destroyed in the war.
points.bm: Masyarakat menumpukan usaha membina semula rumah, ladang dan perniagaan yang musnah akibat perang.

points.en: Many hoped the British government would bring roads, schools and health services.
points.bm: Ramai berharap kerajaan British akan membawa jalan raya, sekolah dan perkhidmatan kesihatan.

question.en: Compare the reactions in Sarawak and Sabah to becoming Crown Colonies.
question.bm: Bandingkan reaksi di Sarawak dan Sabah terhadap status Tanah Jajahan Mahkota.

answer.en: Sarawak had a strong anti-cession movement, including mass resignations and an assassination; in Sabah opposition was limited because British policy suppressed associations and people were focused on rebuilding after the war.
answer.bm: Sarawak mempunyai gerakan anti-penyerahan yang kuat, termasuk peletakan jawatan beramai-ramai dan pembunuhan; di Sabah penentangan terhad kerana dasar British menyekat persatuan dan rakyat menumpukan usaha membina semula kehidupan selepas perang.
